audit_mode: read-only source audit; only this review artifact written; no corpus copies, embeddings, external transmission, installation, or production changes

alloy4fun.trust: Prior index claims only; no fresh parser/semantic replay in this audit. Excluded 4482 files need explicit admission reasons, not inferred incorrect labels.

rights.license_inventory: No LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE files observed in supplied roots; root READMEs do not mention license. Anonymized repository directory names are not license grants.
rights.local_engineering: User explicitly authorizes local dataset development; absence of redistribution clearance is not itself a local engineering blocker.
rights.distribution: Preserve per-origin provenance and license_status=unknown; do not treat anonymization or local authorization as permission to publish corpus/derived artifacts externally.

extraction_admission.initial_supported: Parse with matching Alloy adapter, resolve complete module/import closure and builtins, typecheck, capture predicate source span + binding/type environment + signature/fact context. Admit non-temporal resolved predicates first if production canonicalizer supports their full node/operator set.
extraction_admission.parametric_predicates: Parameter binding and ordered type/multiplicity declarations must survive extraction and alpha-renaming. Do not treat same body with different parameter/context constraints as equivalent. Qualified calls require resolved callee identities.
extraction_admission.imports: Freeze imported module bytes/hashes and parser version. Resolve aliases, parameterized module instantiation, private visibility, and util builtins; reject unresolved/ambiguous imports with machine reason codes. Avoid flattening text.
extraction_admission.anonymization: Use capture-avoiding alpha-renaming by declaration identity; preserve binder scope, arity, multiplicity, types, operator identities and relational role. Remove comments/paths from encoder text but retain private provenance manifest.
extraction_admission.egress: Local-only dataset and training by default; no remote embedding services without separate authorization.

positive_negative_pools.N: For each anchor materialize separate N=3,4,5 views only when at least N admissible candidates exist; never pad with duplicate predicates.
positive_negative_pools.positive: Use verified equivalence under identical typed context and explicit scope/semantics; identical egraph representative is candidate evidence only unless backed by supported verified rewrites. Correct-to-same-exercise label alone is insufficient for equivalence.
positive_negative_pools.negative: Use solver counterexample or certified disequality under frozen context; wrong submission status is not automatic semantic non-equivalence to every positive. Include hard negatives by structural closeness only after verification.
positive_negative_pools.scope: Finite-scope equivalence and universal equivalence require distinct labels. Store scope N separately from pool cardinality N to prevent ambiguity.
positive_negative_pools.prior_metrics: Existing nearest distances, rewards, zero/nonzero canonical distances and correct/incorrect folders are weak supervision; they do not supply proof labels independently.

splits.unit: Union-find connected model families before train/val/test assignment: repository origin, exact/normalized duplicates across Alloy5/6, import closure, canonical/egraph equivalence cluster, exercise variants and student revision lineage.
splits.policy: Deterministic seeded assignment of entire connected groups, targeting 70/15/15 by anchors when feasible. Report actual counts and broad-family held-out evaluation; with only nine broad classified families, exact ratios and balanced operators may be impossible. Never split per file or per predicate.
splits.test_integrity: Fit learned anonymization vocabulary, hard-negative mining, dimensional adapters and embedding training only on training groups. Use validation for selection; freeze test manifest before training.

embedding_contract.hierarchical3072: No observed dataset metadata establishes a pretrained hierarchical3072 encoder. Treat as requested output contract, not a supported existing model claim. Keep named hierarchical view slices, normalization, encoder and tokenizer versions in manifest. A learned projection to 3072 needs training-only fitting and honest model_id; padding a smaller vector is not a learned semantic 3072 encoder.
embedding_contract.LangGraph: Use JSON serializable retrieval record IDs and metadata with local vector-store adapter; graph-state stores query, filters and IDs rather than corpus blobs. Require dimension=3072, metric, normalization, embedding_version, extraction_version, equivalence_context_hash, split and provenance_id.

limitations: Bounded systematic lexical samples (160 files each), not parser-validated full-corpus predicate counts. Samples include generated large files; do not extrapolate counts.
No fresh semantic verification, license adjudication, dataset copy, embedding or training performed.
Prior augmented index must be checked for source-hash/version consistency before reuse.
next_gate: Await Lean assessment and parent synthesis before dataset extraction or embedding implementation.
